channel.title: Pulse blog
channel.description: Notes from building Pulse, an open-source island for Claude Code on Windows and macOS.

item.title: How Pulse sits between Claude Code and your Allow button
item.description: Claude Code HTTP hooks, a PermissionRequest held open until you answer, a per-install token checked with timingSafeEqual, the Stop hook reply trick, and exactly what Connect changes in settings.json.

item.title: Cutting an Electron app’s memory from 530 MB to 315 MB with a 12 KB native helper
item.description: How Pulse 0.2.1 cut memory at launch by replacing a PowerShell media bridge with a tiny C# helper built by the compiler that ships with Windows, and by drawing less glow.

item.title: Why your Mac says 99% RAM (and how Activity Monitor really counts it)
item.description: os.freemem() on macOS leaves out file cache, so a healthy Mac looks full. Here’s how Activity Monitor counts Memory Used, and how to get the same number from vm_stat.
